description: Search suppliers. Pass exactly one of: requirements (Goliath plans up to four requests; continue with plan_offset), searches (one to four explicit supplier/tool/arguments requests built from get_supplier_tools), or award_search (flexible-date award windows, served from cached sources). Live sources run first and cached results are labeled; freshness_policy=live_only refuses cached prices. Each result is the supplier's own data fitted to max_result_chars, plus offers, booking_links and award_observations where Goliath recognizes the response. Long lists come as tables that the reply's tables field explains. Trip details are not stored.

award_recheck.description: Party and cabin context for live award rechecks.

adults.description: Confirm the entire flight party consists of this many adults, with no children or infants. This cannot override conflicting trip requirements or combine travelers from different origins.

cabin.description: Explicitly confirmed cabin for a direct award recheck. Does not authorize changing a conflicting requested cabin or accepting mixed-cabin travel.

enabled.description: Automatically recheck supported cached award candidates when party and cabin are confirmed. Set false to leave cached results unchanged.

award_search.description: Flexible award search across dates and programs.

alliances.description: Operating-carrier alliances, not award-program or transfer eligibility.

loyalty_programs.description: Redemption-program IDs, not bank currencies. Canonical atmos maps explicitly to upstream alaska; Virgin Red, hotel and rail currencies do not map to flight filters.

max_fees_usd_cents.description: Positive supplier screening cap in USD cents: 40000 = USD400. A zero cap is unsupported because upstream zero means unlimited. Preserve the returned original fee currency.

max_points.description: Positive upstream mileage-cost cap, not a cash valuation or party total. Points in different programs are not interchangeable.

transfer_programs.description: Exact bank-program filters supported by Seats.aero. Country-qualified IDs must match the traveler; this screens program relationships and does not verify card eligibility, balances, transfer ratios or timing.

legs.description: Independent directional searches. Outbound and return date windows are searched independently; they do not establish a combined trip or acceptable stay length.

destinations.description: Explicit source-confirmed IATA airport choices accepted by the traveler. Resolve places using search_airports first; do not invent nearby airports or positioning flights.

max_stops.description: Goliath’s sources (and Seats.aero) need an explicit permitted stop count; 0 means nonstop. Qantas requires null to explicitly accept unrestricted stops because its adapter cannot enforce a stop filter.

min_seats.description: Confirmed seats required together for this leg. This is a screening count, not a multiplier or a confirmed party award price.

origins.description: Explicit source-confirmed IATA airport choices accepted by the traveler. Resolve places using search_airports first; do not invent nearby airports or positioning flights.

sort.description: Goliath’s sources default to departure time. Qantas requires source_order because its first-page results do not promise chronological or price ordering. Choose mileage_cost or taxes only when requested and supported; neither establishes the cheapest full journey.

source.description: goliath (the default; seats_aero is accepted as the same choice) searches Goliath’s own award sources: its award cache (prices kept only from airlines that authorized it) and live searches on the airlines that serve the route (Aerolíneas, Bahamasair, RwandAir), up to 330 days ahead. A server that switches Seats.aero on adds its anonymous 60-day cache. Qantas selects the official cached finder with a 353-day horizon, exact airport pair, at most 31 days per leg and 5 seats. Qantas requires max_stops:null and sort:source_order.

freshness_policy.description: Prefer fresh live-capable suppliers; allow clearly labeled cached/published fallback when needed. live_only rejects cached-price sources and disclosed cache-hit inventory.

max_result_chars.description: Approximate character budget for the raw supplier responses in this reply (default 60000). It never costs an option: a response is shortened only where every row cut is still in offers.items (result.omitted lists the cuts); otherwise it is returned whole and marked result.over_budget.

plan_offset.description: Offset from a previous reply next_offset.

requirements.description: Trip requirements for a planned round-trip search.

adults.description: Shorthand adult count (defaults to 1 with origin) when travelers is omitted.

origin.description: Shorthand departure airport IATA code or city name when travelers is omitted.

rewards.description: Optional award-flight preferences, independent of cash searches.

cabin.description: Exact cabin for award-flight searches only; does not set the cash-flight cabin or permit mixed-cabin awards.

loyalty_programs.description: Exact redemption-program IDs, such as aeroplan, flyingblue, united or virginatlantic. These select mileage programs, not operating airlines or transferable bank points. Unknown IDs are retained; automatic award searches are skipped with a warning if any selected program cannot be mapped.

transfer_programs.description: Exact bank-program filters supported by Seats.aero, such as amexus, amexca, bilt or chaseus. Country-qualified IDs must match the traveler. These filter transfer relationships only; they do not establish card eligibility, balances, ratios, bonuses or available awards. Bank balances are not award-program mileage caps.

result_detail.description: offers leaves out the supplier response wherever Goliath built normalized offers, keeping offers, booking_links and award_observations. full (default) returns both.

searches.description: One to four explicit supplier tool calls.

fallback_for.description: Indexes of earlier live searches in this same batch for the same route/dates/party/product intent. Only for a cached fallback. Caller asserts equivalent intent; never group unrelated routes or cash and award products.

name: search_travel
title: Search travel and reward sources
